verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at the 6–6.5 anchor because its spacious, clearly sectioned layout is readable with effort, but very small type, pervasive node-label truncation, and one long backtracking edge prevent comfortable arm’s-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Stages and label chips have generous clear space, but the oversized canvas makes the already small text difficult to read at arm’s length.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Light bordered regions with numbered headers make section membership immediately clear, including the distinct three-node rebuild section.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Most colored edges are clean and uncrossed, but the dashed teal “published indexes” route makes a long horizontal backtrack across the board and several connections are visually interrupted by large section gaps.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Ink density is low and sections contain only one to three nodes, but excessive unused canvas area shrinks the meaningful content and contributes to tiny, frequently ellipsized node labels.
